changelog:
- Initial release: Provides read-only listing of all Huawei Cloud IAM projects for an authenticated account.
- Uses KooCLI `hcloud IAM KeystoneListProjects` as the primary method, with fallback to huaweicloudsdkiam Python SDK.
- Supports filtering by project name, domain ID, status, parent project, and pagination.
- No credential prompting; works with existing authenticated CLI or environment variables.
- Clear documentation of prerequisites, command examples, and use cases for inventory, resource discovery, and permission review.
summary: Lists Huawei Cloud IAM (Identity and Access Management) projects — enumerates all projects under the authenticated account with project ID, name, domain ID, parent ID, enabled status and description, using the KooCLI `hcloud IAM KeystoneListProjects` command (primary) or the huaweicloudsdkiam Python SDK (fallback). Provides read-only project inventory for account management, resource discovery, permission review and multi-region operations planning. Use this skill whenever the user mentions project list query. Triggers include: list projects, project list, query projects, enumerate projects, show projects, project inventory, 查询项目, 项目列表, 查看项目, 列出项目, 获取项目列表, 华为云项目, 查询华为云项目列表.
